IFGS.description: Initial Force for Geometric Stiffness (IFGS). Keyed by element number; each entry sets the initial force direction and magnitude used to build the element geometric stiffness.

DIR.description: Initial force direction (case-insensitive). AXIAL = along the element axis; GX/GY/GZ = along the global X/Y/Z axes.

INIT_FORCE.description: Initial force magnitude applied in the DIR direction, used to form the geometric stiffness of the element.

manual_title: Large Displacement - Initial Forces for Geometric Stiffness
